privacy.title: Your data & privacy
privacy.subtitle: Manage how Korume stores and uses your personal learning data.
privacy.checkFailedTitle: We couldn't check for a pending request
privacy.checkFailedBody: This is usually temporary. Try refreshing the page in a moment; the options below still work as normal.

aiTraining.title: Help improve Korume's models
aiTraining.body: Let us use your recordings and learning data to improve our models. Off unless you turn it on. Your Companion remembers your learning either way — that is not model training.

memory.title: Delete Korume Memory
memory.body: Remove what Companion remembers about your journey.

closeAccount.title: Delete Account
closeAccount.body: Close your Korume account. Your learning data is kept, and you can come back.

eraseAll.title: Delete all my data
eraseAll.body: Request permanent deletion of your personal data stored by Korume.

deleteDialog.support: If you need help, contact Korume Support.
deleteDialog.failed: We couldn't schedule the deletion. Please try again.
deleteDialog.alreadyPending: A deletion request is already in progress for your account.
deleteDialog.signedOut: Your session has expired. Please sign in again to continue.
deleteDialog.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

erase_all.title: Delete all my data
erase_all.subtitle: Remove the personal data Korume has stored about you.

profile.title: Profile & preferences
profile.body: Your profile information, settings and learning preferences.

progress.title: Learning progress
progress.body: Lessons, practice history, review progress and achievements.

memory.title: Korume Memory
memory.body: Information remembered by Companion about your learning journey.

companion.title: Companion history
companion.body: Diary entries, reflections, conversations and personalized observations.

saved.title: Saved learning content
saved.body: Bookmarks, reviews, generated lessons and saved practice material.

practice.title: Practice history
practice.body: Certification practice results, mistakes, answers and review history.

erase_all.note: You have 7 days to change your mind. We keep your data untouched until then, and you can cancel any time from this page. Some records may be retained where required for legal, security, or billing purposes.
erase_all.confirmHeading: Are you sure you want to continue?
erase_all.confirmBody: After the 7 days pass, your learning history and personal Korume data will no longer be available to you.
erase_all.acknowledge: I understand my data will be deleted after 7 days.

close_account.title: Close your account
close_account.subtitle: Close your Korume account. Your learning data is not deleted.
close_account.whatHeading: What happens when you close your account?

profile.title: Profile & preferences
profile.body: Kept as they are. You will not be able to sign in to view or edit them until you reopen your account.

progress.title: Learning progress
progress.body: Kept. Your lessons, practice history and achievements are preserved for when you come back.

memory.title: Korume Memory
memory.body: Kept. Companion's memory of your learning journey is preserved, not erased.

companion.title: Companion history
companion.body: Kept. Diary entries, reflections and conversations stay stored.

saved.title: Saved learning content
saved.body: Kept. Bookmarks, reviews and saved practice material stay stored.

practice.title: Practice history
practice.body: Kept. Certification practice results and review history stay stored.

close_account.note: You have 7 days to change your mind. Your account stays open and fully usable until then, and you can cancel any time from this page. Closing your account does not delete your learning data.
close_account.confirmHeading: Are you sure you want to close your account?
close_account.confirmBody: After the 7 days pass, you will be signed out and unable to access Korume with this account. Your learning data stays stored — closing is not the same as deleting it.
close_account.acknowledge: I understand my account will close after 7 days, and that my learning data will be kept, not deleted.

pending.cancelled: Your deletion request was cancelled. Nothing was removed.
pending.failed: We couldn't cancel the request. Please try again.

erase_all.title: Deletion scheduled
erase_all.body: Your data is scheduled for deletion on {date}. Nothing has been removed yet.
erase_all.switchNote: Want to close your account and keep your data instead? Cancel this request first, then choose "Delete Account."

close_account.title: Account closure scheduled
close_account.body: Your account is scheduled to close on {date}. Your learning data will be kept, not deleted.
close_account.switchNote: Want to delete all your data instead? Cancel this request first, then choose "Delete all my data."
